rci1_using_msad.detail: HCP-D (the training reference cohort) is a multi-site dataset; per the cited Somerville et al. 2018 reference (ref [27]), HCP-D was collected across multiple sites using harmonized 3T Siemens Prisma scanners. The paper text refers to a single scanner model but does not explicitly enumerate sites for HCP-D.
rci1_using_msad.supporting_text: "brain imaging data were collected using a 3T Siemens Prisma scanner (Siemens, Erlangen, Germany)" and "we used an additional cohort of 652 neurologically healthy children and adolescents from the Lifespan Human Connectome Project Development (HCP-D) dataset [27]."
rci1_using_msad.location: Lee2025.pdf.md: Methods / Data acquisition; Methods / Study participants

rci2_using_epd.detail: HCP-D (a variant of HCP) was used as the sole reference cohort for normative model training. ABIDE TD was subsequently used for intercept re-estimation during transfer, functionally serving as a reference cohort in the adapted model.
rci2_using_epd.supporting_text: "To construct a normative developmental trajectory, we used an additional cohort of 652 neurologically healthy children and adolescents from the Lifespan Human Connectome Project Development (HCP-D) dataset [27]." "A normative model for the gradient values was constructed using the HCP-D dataset and then transferred to the TD group of the ABIDE dataset."
rci2_using_epd.location: Lee2025.pdf.md: Methods / Study participants; Methods / Normative modeling

rci3_epd_name.detail: HCP-D (Lifespan Human Connectome Project Development, a variant of HCP) used for normative model training. ABIDE I and II TD cohorts used for intercept re-estimation in the transfer step, effectively serving as the reference population for the applied normative model.
rci3_epd_name.supporting_text: "Two large-scale independent datasets from the Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange (ABIDE), termed the ABIDE I and II..." "we used an additional cohort of 652 neurologically healthy children and adolescents from the Lifespan Human Connectome Project Development (HCP-D) dataset [27]."

rci5_n.detail: Training phase; 652 neurologically healthy TD children and adolescents from HCP-D used for normative model construction; the model was subsequently transferred to ABIDE TD with intercept re-estimation.
rci5_n.supporting_text: "we used an additional cohort of 652 neurologically healthy children and adolescents from the Lifespan Human Connectome Project Development (HCP-D) dataset"

rci6_sex.detail: Training phase HCP-D; paper reports 301 males and 251 females (sum=552), which does not match stated total N=652; discrepancy of 100 participants is unaccounted for in the paper; percentages calculated against total N=652; female_pct + male_pct = 84.7% due to this discrepancy.
rci6_sex.supporting_text: "These participants (aged 5-21 years [14.44 ± 4.06, mean ± standard deviation], 301 males and 251 females)"

rci7_age.detail: Training phase HCP-D; age in years; mean and SD directly reported; range specified as 5-21 years for HCP-D participants (the abstract states 5-22 years referring to all datasets, but the methods section specifies 5-21 for HCP-D specifically).
rci7_age.supporting_text: "These participants (aged 5-21 years [14.44 ± 4.06, mean ± standard deviation], 301 males and 251 females)"
